principle: Only concrete launch-blocking gaps are status blockers. Private housing providers and secondary housing sources are post-launch enrichment unless the designated municipal/main housing source itself fails. For jobs, the designated launch source is Arbetsförmedlingen/JobSearch; additional job sources are post-launch enrichment unless the launch feed itself is broken or demonstrably drops its own current municipal results.
